classification_routing_rules.content: Lead Classification Routing Rules v4.2. Priority = HIGH if est. value >= $100,000 OR flagged urgent OR existing-account expansion; MEDIUM if $25,000-$99,999; LOW if < $25,000 or 'browsing'/no budget. Score 0-100 = 0.6*value_band + 0.3*intent_signal + 0.1*recency. HIGH-priority leads route to enterprise AE pod and #priority-leads; MEDIUM to inside sales; LOW to nurture sequence. Leads must be created in Salesforce only after manager sign-off on the batch.

tools.name: lookup_existing_account
tools.description: Look up existing Salesforce account records to detect whether an inquiry is an expansion on a current customer.

tools.name: score_inquiry_against_rules
tools.description: Apply the routing rules to each inquiry to compute a draft priority band and 0-100 score, flagging anomalies and ambiguous cases.

tools.name: draft_lead_routing_batch
tools.description: Assemble a consolidated routing sheet of all classified inquiries with proposed priority, score, owner, and destination, saved as a draft for the manager's review.
